Rot — Cursed Technique Reversal

Your blood is blood red, healthy and capable of healing the body whenever it touches it. Whenever you use a Rot Technique, you can choose to cause the damage taken to instead heal that amount of hit points instead of damaging. Additionally, you can spend 2 additional cursed energy when using a Rot Technique or Rotten Blood so whenever it damages a creature, whether through an attack roll or a saving throw, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, nothing happens. On a success, they regain additional hit points equal to twice your Rotten Blood damage.
